name: StaBillon PLN
oneLiner: PLNdt is StaBillon's Polish zloty e-money token, backed by currency-matched reserves and redeemable at par after account and identity checks.
collateral: The issuer describes segregated PLN bank deposits and eligible liquid PLN instruments backing each zloty token one-for-one. A current allocation and named reserve institutions have not been verified.
pegMechanism: StaBillon's whitepaper grants par redemption without an issuer redemption fee, subject to an account and AML checks. Additional verification can extend settlement to five business days. This is a documented issuer route, not a modeled Pharos backstop.
launchPhaseDetail: StaBillon's company news says EURdt and PLNdt have been live and used by customers since August 2026. Positive Ethereum token stock and three decimals were verified on November 15. Billon Unified Blockchain is also described by the issuer but is not a registered Pharos chain; its supply and the whole-asset reconciliation remain unverified. No admitted price or whole-asset supply lane is established.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: the exact Ethereum quote is absent. No admitted whole-asset supply lane: Ethereum issuance is positive, but Billon DLT supply reconciliation is unverified.

milestones.title: StaBillon publishes its European e-money token whitepaper
milestones.description: The whitepaper names EURODT and PLNDT among its currency tokens and describes reserve, redemption and holder-control arrangements. Its October 2025 pilot schedule is not evidence of public launch.

milestones.title: Issuer reports EURdt and PLNdt in customer use
milestones.description: StaBillon's company news dates live customer use to August 2026 without naming an exact day.

milestones.title: Public Ethereum issuance verified
milestones.description: Pinned Ethereum block 26423509 confirms a positive PLNdt totalSupply and three decimals. This establishes Ethereum token stock, not circulating market cap or complete Billon DLT liabilities.
